description: Append-only ledger of every level the user has earned, and why. The user's level is the sum of levels_awarded plus 1 - it is never stored as a standalone counter. Import TWENTY-FOURTH (no dependencies)
notes: APPEND-ONLY. Rows are never updated and never deleted. A mistaken award is corrected by a compensating 'manual' row, never by an edit.
LEVELS ONLY GO UP. levels_awarded is always >= 1. The app never writes a negative. This is what makes the history truthful - a record can never explain a level the user no longer has.
Level is SUMMED from this table, not read from a counter. game_state.level and localStorage are caches that get repaired to match this ledger, never trusted over it.
ref_id is a plain number, NOT a Baserow link field, on purpose: level records must be writable before the campaigns table (import 16) exists, and a link would hard-couple the import order.

idempotency_key is the only thing preventing a double award when a completion is submitted twice. The client checks for an existing row with that key before creating. Baserow cannot enforce uniqueness across a race, so this is best-effort.

TAMPER-EVIDENT, NOT TAMPER-RESISTANT. The Baserow API token ships in the client bundle, so any user can forge rows. level_before/level_after form a chain that makes a gap VISIBLE, nothing more. Never gate money, ranking, or paid entitlements on level until writes go through a server-side proxy that verifies the Xano JWT.
